sub_graphs.title: Prague: BLS12-381 G1 Curve Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the G1 point operations including addition, multi-scalar multiplication, and field mapping

nodes.label: G1 Addition Precompile Called
nodes.description: bls12_g1_add precompile invoked with two G1 points as input

nodes.label: Validate G1 Add Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input length equals exactly 256 bytes (2 x 128-byte G1 points)

nodes.label: G1 Add Input Invalid
nodes.description: Input length validation failed, InvalidParameter raised

nodes.label: Charge G1 Add Gas
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BLS_G1_ADD (500 gas) from available gas

nodes.label: Decode G1 Points
nodes.description: Convert two 128-byte inputs to G1 points using bytes_to_g1()

nodes.label: Perform G1 Point Addition
nodes.description: Execute bls12_add(p1, p2) for elliptic curve point addition

nodes.label: Encode G1 Result
nodes.description: Serialize result point to 128 bytes using g1_to_bytes()

nodes.label: G1 Addition Complete
nodes.description: Result written to evm.output

nodes.label: G1 MSM Precompile Called
nodes.description: bls12_g1_msm (multi-scalar multiplication) invoked

nodes.label: Validate G1 MSM Input
nodes.description: Verify input length > 0 and divisible by 160 (128-byte point + 32-byte scalar)

nodes.label: G1 MSM Input Invalid
nodes.description: Input validation failed for MSM operation

nodes.label: Calculate G1 MSM Gas
nodes.description: Compute gas as k * GAS_BLS_G1_MUL * discount / MULTIPLIER based on pair count

nodes.label: Iterate G1 MSM Pairs
nodes.description: For each pair: decode point, decode scalar, perform bls12_multiply, accumulate result

nodes.label: G1 MSM Complete
nodes.description: Accumulated result serialized and written to output

nodes.label: Validate FP Input
nodes.description: Verify input length equals 64 bytes and value < field modulus

nodes.label: FP Input Invalid
nodes.description: Field element validation failed

nodes.label: Map and Clear Cofactor
nodes.description: Execute clear_cofactor_G1(map_to_curve_G1(FQ(fp)))

nodes.label: Map FP to G1 Complete
nodes.description: Mapped G1 point written to output

sub_graphs.title: Prague: BLS12-381 Pairing Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the pairing precompile including subgroup validation and batch pairing verification

nodes.label: Pairing Precompile Called
nodes.description: bls12_pairing precompile invoked for pairing check

nodes.label: Validate Pairing Input Length
nodes.description: Verify input length > 0 and divisible by 384 (128 G1 + 256 G2)

nodes.label: Pairing Input Invalid
nodes.description: Input length validation failed

nodes.label: Calculate Pairing Gas
nodes.description: Compute gas as 32600 * k + 37700 where k = len(data) / 384

nodes.label: Pairing Gas Charged
nodes.description: Gas successfully deducted for pairing operation

nodes.label: Decode G1 Point for Pairing
nodes.description: Extract and decode 128-byte G1 point from input pair

nodes.label: Decode G2 Point for Pairing
nodes.description: Extract and decode 256-byte G2 point from input pair

nodes.label: Validate G1 Subgroup Membership
nodes.description: Verify bls12_multiply(g1_point, curve_order) equals point at infinity

nodes.label: G1 Subgroup Check Failed
nodes.description: G1 point not in correct subgroup, InvalidParameter raised

nodes.label: Validate G2 Subgroup Membership
nodes.description: Verify bls12_multiply(g2_point, curve_order) equals point at infinity

nodes.label: G2 Subgroup Check Failed
nodes.description: G2 point not in correct subgroup, InvalidParameter raised

nodes.label: Subgroup Checks Passed
nodes.description: Both G1 and G2 points verified to be in correct subgroups

nodes.label: Compute Pairing
nodes.description: Execute pairing(g2_point, g1_point) and accumulate result

nodes.label: Compare to Identity
nodes.description: Check if accumulated result equals FQ12.one()

nodes.label: Pairing Result is One
nodes.description: Pairing check successful, product equals multiplicative identity

nodes.label: Pairing Result Not One
nodes.description: Pairing check failed, product does not equal identity

nodes.label: Output Success (0x01)
nodes.description: Write 32 bytes with 0x01 at position 31 to output

nodes.label: Output Failure (0x00)
nodes.description: Write 32 zero bytes to output

nodes.label: Pairing Operation Complete
nodes.description: Pairing precompile execution finished

sub_graphs.title: Prague: BLS12-381 Gas Economics
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas calculation mechanisms for BLS12-381 precompiles including MSM discount tiers

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G1_ADD Constant
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost for G1 point addition (500 gas)

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G2_ADD Constant
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost for G2 point addition

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G1_MUL Constant
nodes.description: Base gas cost for G1 scalar multiplication

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G2_MUL Constant
nodes.description: Base gas cost for G2 scalar multiplication

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G1_MAP Constant
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost for mapping field element to G1

nodes.label: GAS_BLS_G2_MAP Constant
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost for mapping FQ2 element to G2

nodes.label: MULTIPLIER Constant
nodes.description: Divisor for discount calculation in MSM operations

nodes.label: MSM Gas Calculation Start
nodes.description: Beginning multi-scalar multiplication gas calculation

nodes.label: Count Pairs
nodes.description: Calculate k = input_length / LENGTH_PER_PAIR

nodes.label: Lookup Discount Factor
nodes.description: Get discount from G1_K_DISCOUNT or G2_K_DISCOUNT based on k

nodes.label: k Within Discount Table
nodes.description: k <= 128, use table lookup for discount

nodes.label: k Exceeds Discount Table
nodes.description: k > 128, use maximum discount (G1_MAX_DISCOUNT or G2_MAX_DISCOUNT)

nodes.label: Compute MSM Gas
nodes.description: Calculate k * GAS_BLS_Gx_MUL * discount / MULTIPLIER

nodes.label: MSM Gas Determined
nodes.description: Final MSM gas cost calculated

nodes.label: Pairing Gas Calculation Start
nodes.description: Beginning pairing gas calculation

nodes.label: Compute Pairing Gas
nodes.description: Calculate 32600 * k + 37700

nodes.label: Pairing Gas Determined
nodes.description: Final pairing gas cost calculated

nodes.label: Validate Input Length
nodes.description: Check input length matches expected format for operation

nodes.label: Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input length does not match specification

nodes.label: Validate Field Element
nodes.description: Verify field element is less than field modulus

nodes.label: Field Element Invalid

nodes.label: Point Not On Curve

nodes.label: Point Not In Subgroup

nodes.label: All Validations Passed

ambiguities.text: The index page does not specify the exact precompile addresses for BLS12-381 operations
The 'naive approach' mentioned for MSM implementation could have different performance characteristics
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the naive iterative approach is functionally correct but note that production implementations should use optimized algorithms like Pippenger's method.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when MSM receives an empty set of pairs after length validation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume input length == 0 is caught by length validation. If somehow bypassed, return the point at infinity as the identity element for addition.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLS12-381 curve implementation is assumed to be constant-time to prevent timing side-channel attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timing attacks could leak private key material during signature operations or enable distinguishing attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot provide points that pass subgroup checks but cause exceptional behavior in pairing computation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Specially crafted inputs could cause denial of service, incorrect pairing results, or cryptographic breaks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying field arithmetic library correctly implements BLS12-381 field operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect field arithmetic could lead to signature forgery, invalid proof acceptance, or consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas costs are calibrated to prevent denial of service through computationally expensive BLS operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced BLS operations could be exploited to slow down or halt block processing.

implicit_assumptions.description: Subgroup membership checks prevent small subgroup attacks by verifying point^order = infinity
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Points in small subgroups could break security properties of pairing-based protocols.
